steps.en: Install the desktop app and connect a model: Genspark login or your own key
steps.zh: 装好桌面应用，接上模型：登录 Genspark 或填自己的 key

steps.en: Open a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx and type the edit you want in the AI panel
steps.zh: 打开 .docx、.xlsx 或 .pptx，在 AI 面板里写下要改什么

steps.en: The agent reads only the blocks it needs and applies the change in place
steps.zh: agent 只读它需要的块，在原处改好

steps.en: Lands edits as Word-style tracked changes; each AI turn is a snapshot you can roll back
steps.zh: 改动落成 Word 式修订，每轮 AI 都是可回滚的快照

steps.en: Review the revisions, then accept or roll back
On save, splices only edited blocks into the original XML; the rest is copied byte-for-byte
steps.zh: 保存时只把改过的块拼回原 XML，其余逐字节复制

value.en: A reviewed AI edit of a real Office file that still opens cleanly in Word, Excel and PowerPoint — no chatbot copy-paste, no re-formatting
value.zh: 审过的 AI 改动落在真 Office 文件里，Word 照常打开，不用来回粘贴、手工重排
